name: Horizon CTA
description: A closing call to action where a sunrise is drawn in ordered (Bayer) dither: light quantised into three colours, a crisp horizon hairline and a scanline reflection.

props.name: muted
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 45% white.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Label in the pill above the headline.

props.name: primary
props.description: White primary button. Hover warms a glow beneath it and nudges the arrow 2px; nothing jumps.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Dark glass secondary button that stays legible over the light.

props.name: notes
props.description: Three reassurance notes along the bottom.

props.name: glow
props.description: Light colours, hottest first: core, mid, outer. The dither quantises between them.

props.name: cell
props.description: Dither cell size in CSS px. 3 reads as texture, 5 as pixel art.
